# materials.types: ClearCoatLayer

This slice: ClearCoatLayer, SheenLayer, SpecularLayer, TransmissionLayer, IridescenceLayer, AnisotropyLayer, SubsurfaceParameters, LayeredMaterial.

```plato

//==
// # Material layers (glTF-extension shaped)
//
// The optional appearance layers stacked over the metallic-roughness base of
// the section above, one record per glTF material extension, plus the fully
// layered surface that gathers them. Each record documents its own disabling
// convention (zero strength or black color), so an absent layer is simply a
// disabled one.

// A thin lacquer layer over the base surface (car paint, varnish). Intensity 0
// disables the layer. IndexOfRefraction is 1.5 in the glTF extension.
type ClearCoatLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Intensity: Proportion;
    Roughness: Proportion;
    NormalScale: Number;
    IndexOfRefraction: Number;
}

// Micro-fiber retroreflection for cloth (velvet, satin). A black Color
// disables the layer. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retroreflector)
type SheenLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Color: Color;
    Roughness: Proportion;
}

// Adjustable dielectric specular reflectance (glTF KHR_materials_specular).
// Strength scales the reflectance amount and Color tints it; Strength 1 with
// a white Color is the physical default.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Specular_reflection)
type SpecularLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Strength: Proportion;
    Color: Color;
}

// Light transmission through the surface with volume attenuation (glass,
// liquids, gemstones). Transmission 0 disables the layer. Thickness and
// AttenuationDistance are in scene units: light traveling AttenuationDistance
// through the medium is tinted to AttenuationColor.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Refractive_index)
type TransmissionLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Transmission: Proportion;
    IndexOfRefraction: Number;
    Thickness: Number;
    AttenuationColor: Color;
    AttenuationDistance: Number;
}

// Thin-film interference (soap bubbles, oil slicks, beetle shells). Intensity
// 0 disables the layer. Film thickness varies between ThicknessMinimum and
// ThicknessMaximum, measured in nanometers per the glTF extension.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thin-film_interference)
type IridescenceLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Intensity: Proportion;
    IndexOfRefraction: Number;
    ThicknessMinimum: Number;
    ThicknessMaximum: Number;
}

// Direction-dependent roughness (brushed metal, hair, vinyl). Strength 0
// disables the layer; Rotation turns the tangent-space anisotropy direction.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anisotropy)
type AnisotropyLayer
    implements IValue
{
    Strength: Proportion;
    Rotation: Angle;
}

// Sub-surface light diffusion (skin, wax, marble). Radius is the per-channel
// mean free path in scene units, uniformly scaled by Scale (0 disables);
// Anisotropy is the Henyey-Greenstein g in [-1, 1].
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Subsurface_scattering)
type SubsurfaceParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Color: Color;
    Radius: Number3;
    Scale: Number;
    Anisotropy: Number;
}

// A fully layered surface: a textured metallic-roughness base plus every
// optional layer. Each layer's zero/black convention (see the layer docs)
// marks it disabled, so a plain surface is representable without waste.
type LayeredMaterial
    implements IValue
{
    Base: TexturedMaterial;
    ClearCoat: ClearCoatLayer;
    Sheen: SheenLayer;
    Specular: SpecularLayer;
    Transmission: TransmissionLayer;
    Iridescence: IridescenceLayer;
    Anisotropy: AnisotropyLayer;
    Subsurface: SubsurfaceParameters;
}
```
